name: Spy ni Kiss to Juudan o
original_name: スパイにキスと銃弾を
source: You joined a trading company and discovered its most important secret: the existence of the Umeboshi Division, a department involved with external affairs that takes care of certain type of incidents. After being involved with them, you join the department, and between each incident you may find love...
translation: 你加入了一家商社，发现了它最重要的秘密：梅干部门的存在，这是一个负责处理某些类型事件的对外事务部门。与他们交往后，你加入了这个部门，在每一次事件之间你可能会找到爱情……
